To find the stationary points of a function y = f(x), first, find the first derivative of the function (f'(x)). Then, set the first derivative equal to zero (f'(x) = 0) and solve for x. Finally, to determine the nature of the stationary points, find the second derivative (f''(x)) and evaluate it at the x-coordinates of the stationary points.
